explication: Dashboard Icons combines a curated icon catalogue with a website for discovery and downloads, community submissions and review, external icon collections, and an MCP interface for AI clients. The main user journey is browse or search, inspect an icon, then download or copy its link; contributors can submit icons for review and publication. The README documents these capabilities, while sampled source confirms selected review, PocketBase, MCP, and external-icon relationships. Several page and service implementations were not sampled, so undocumented internal connections are omitted.
